runs.review_method: Full decode and 20 chronological frames at 4fps across the five-second take, with sampled geometry/lighting review; no claim of exhaustive frame-level artifact detection.
runs.review: Paper fold, blank note cards and contact shadows remain coherent in the samples. Slow push changes scale without visible object transformation. No text, people or logos. The top-left notebook edge is incidental, and left negative space is narrower than requested; readable title placement requires a separate dark side panel/overlay. Accept whole take as a simple product still life; edit uses 0–4s.
